_TEMPLATE_GUIDE._purpose: Provide this file to an LLM to generate a new quiz module. Fill in the fields marked with <FILL_IN>. Remove all '_comment' and '_TEMPLATE_GUIDE' keys from the final output.
_TEMPLATE_GUIDE._top_level_structure: The root object contains one key per module. Each module key is a plain string name (e.g. 'Les Pronoms', 'Le Subjonctif'). A module contains: _description, _intro, and one or more quiz keys.
_TEMPLATE_GUIDE._quiz_key_naming: Quiz keys follow the pattern: '<Topic> - <Level>'. Examples: 'Pronoms COD & COI - A2', 'Subjonctif Présent - B1', 'Révision Mixte - B2'. The level suffix (A1, A2, B1, B2, C1) is optional but recommended.

_intro_html_guide._purpose: The _intro value is an HTML table string rendered before the quiz. It summarises the grammar rule visually. Produce clean, compact HTML — no extra whitespace between tags on the same row.
_intro_html_guide._colgroup: Define column widths summing to 100%. 3 columns at 33%/33%/34% is standard. Omit the 'action-col' (that is added automatically by the renderer).

_row_types.title-row: tr.title-row — Main title. First cell is <th> (bold), second cell spans 2 columns and gives a one-sentence description.
_row_types.blank-row: tr.blank-row — Empty spacer row. Use  .
_row_types.focus-point: tr.focus-point — Highlighted rule or definition. First cell is <th> (label), second cell spans 2 and contains the rule (bold key terms).
_row_types.section-header: tr.section-header — Section divider. One <td colspan='3'> with a letter prefix, e.g. 'A. Les pronoms sujets'.
_row_types.explanation: tr.explanation — Detail row. Three cells: term/form | explanation | example. Use Explication / Exemple as column headers after section-header.

_intro_html_guide._inline_formatting: Use <b> for key terms, <i> for meta-labels, <u> for the replaced noun in examples, <span style='color:#548DD4;'> for COD pronouns (blue), <span style='color:#FF0000;'> for COI (red), <span style='color:#00B050;'> for Y/EN (green), <span style='color:#F79646;'> for general highlights (orange).

MultipleChoice._description: Student picks ONE correct answer from 4 options.
MultipleChoice._Options: Exactly 4 options, comma-separated. Include plausible distractors.
MultipleChoice._Answer: Exactly one of the Options values.
MultipleChoice._Question_tip: Use ___ (3 underscores) as the blank placeholder in fill-in-context sentences.

FillInBlank._description: Student types the answer freely (no options shown).
FillInBlank._Answer: The exact expected string. Accept only one value.
FillInBlank._Question_tip: Always include ___ in the sentence to show where to type.

OddOneOut._description: Student identifies the item that does NOT belong to a group.
OddOneOut._Options: Exactly 4 options, comma-separated. One is the odd one out.
OddOneOut._Question_tip: Phrase the question as 'Lequel/Laquelle n'est PAS...' or 'Quel mot ne va pas avec...'

Vocabulary._description: Student matches a word or phrase to its definition or translation.
Vocabulary._Question_tip: State the word/phrase to identify, e.g. 'Que signifie "se souvenir" ?'

_feedback_tips: FeedbackCorrect: confirm why the answer is right in one sentence. Start with an encouragement word (Bravo !, Exact !, Bien !, Parfait !).
FeedbackIncorrect: explain the rule that applies. Start with 'Faux.', 'Non.', or 'Incorrect.' then give the rule.
Both feedbacks should reference the specific form used in the question, not just the abstract rule.
_TEMPLATE_GUIDE._multi_select_note: Answer can contain multiple comma-separated values when more than one option is correct (e.g. "le, la"). The student must select all of them. Use this sparingly.

YOUR_MODULE_NAME._comment_module: Replace 'YOUR_MODULE_NAME' with the actual module name. This key is displayed as the topic title in the student app.
YOUR_MODULE_NAME._description: <FILL_IN: one short sentence describing the module, e.g. 'Les pronoms personnels en français'>

YOUR_MODULE_NAME._comment_quizzes: Add one key per quiz level below. Suggested progression: A2 (basic recognition), B1 (production), B2 (complex / mixed).

QUIZ_TOPIC - A2._comment: REMOVE this _comment key in the final output. Replace 'QUIZ_TOPIC' with the grammar point name (matching the module name is fine). Each quiz is an array of question objects. Aim for 10–15 questions per quiz, mixing all relevant types.
QUIZ_TOPIC - A2._type: THIS IS A COMMENT KEY — REMOVE IT. The value of this quiz key must be a plain array [], not an object. See the correct format below.

QUIZ_TOPIC - A2_QUESTIONS._comment: REMOVE this object in the final output. It is documentation only.
QUIZ_TOPIC - A2_QUESTIONS._note: Each quiz is a JSON array of question objects. The key above ('QUIZ_TOPIC - A2') maps directly to this array — there is no wrapper object.

QUIZ_TOPIC - A2_QUESTIONS._comment_type: One correct answer out of 4 options. Use ___ as the blank in the sentence.
QUIZ_TOPIC - A2_QUESTIONS.Question: <FILL_IN: Complete sentence with ___ placeholder, e.g. 'Tu vois Marie ? → Oui, je ___ vois.'>
QUIZ_TOPIC - A2_QUESTIONS.Options: <FILL_IN: 4 comma-separated options, e.g. 'le, la, les, lui'>
QUIZ_TOPIC - A2_QUESTIONS.FeedbackCorrect: <FILL_IN: Why it is correct, e.g. 'Bravo ! Marie est féminin singulier → COD = la.'>
QUIZ_TOPIC - A2_QUESTIONS.FeedbackIncorrect: <FILL_IN: Rule reminder, e.g. 'Faux. Marie (féminin singulier) est COD → la.'>

QUIZ_TOPIC - A2_QUESTIONS._comment_type: Student types freely. Options must be empty string. Use ___ in the question.
QUIZ_TOPIC - A2_QUESTIONS.Question: <FILL_IN: Sentence with ___ placeholder, e.g. 'Il mange les pommes. → Il ___ mange.'>

QUIZ_TOPIC - A2_QUESTIONS._comment_type: Options must always be exactly 'Vrai, Faux'. Answer must be 'Vrai' or 'Faux'.
QUIZ_TOPIC - A2_QUESTIONS.Question: <FILL_IN: A statement about the grammar rule, e.g. 'Le pronom COD le peut remplacer un nom féminin singulier.'>

QUIZ_TOPIC - A2_QUESTIONS._comment_type: Student identifies the item that does NOT belong. Exactly 4 options.
QUIZ_TOPIC - A2_QUESTIONS.Question: <FILL_IN: e.g. 'Quel pronom n'est PAS un pronom COD ?'>
QUIZ_TOPIC - A2_QUESTIONS.Options: <FILL_IN: 4 comma-separated items, one of which does not belong>
QUIZ_TOPIC - A2_QUESTIONS.FeedbackCorrect: <FILL_IN: Why this item is the odd one out>
QUIZ_TOPIC - A2_QUESTIONS.FeedbackIncorrect: <FILL_IN: Explain which item is the odd one out and why>

QUIZ_TOPIC - A2_QUESTIONS._comment_type: Student matches a word/phrase to its meaning. Minimum 3 options.
QUIZ_TOPIC - A2_QUESTIONS.Question: <FILL_IN: e.g. 'Que signifie "se souvenir de" en anglais ?'>
